items.t: Why Is Cipher Digital Stock Falling on Friday?
items.sum: Discover why Cipher Digital Inc. (NASDAQ: CIFR) stock is falling Friday amid Bitcoin price declines, broader Nasdaq weakness, and an AI sector selloff.

items.t: Cipher Digital's $16.6B Contracted Revenues: Can Growth Accelerate?
items.sum: CIFR secures 700 MW of HPC capacity, representing $16.6 billion in base-term revenues, with long-term leases supporting future growth.

items.t: Cipher Digital Hovers Near Flatline After Anthropic's $83 IPO Pricing
items.sum: Cipher Digital is hovering near the flatline Thursday after Anthropic's IPO priced at $83 per share, lifting AI cloud services peers.

items.t: Cipher Digital Stock Down 55% YTD: Is the Selloff Overdone?
items.sum: Cipher Digital's 55% YTD stock plunge raises valuation questions as $16.6B in HPC contracts fuels growth hopes, but debt and execution risks cloud the outlook.

items.t: TeraWulf Rises 6%, Cipher Digital Gains 5% After NVIDIA’s Record Quarter; IREN Climbs 4%
items.sum: NVIDIA's blowout forecast lit up the former bitcoin miners now leasing AI data centers, but a quiet warning about chip financing could shake the rally. Three stocks share one thesis, and they are not equally exposed.

items.t: Why Is Cipher Digital Stock Surging on Wednesday?
items.sum: Find out why Cipher Digital Inc. (NASDAQ: CIFR) stock is rising on Wednesday following Nvidia's Q3 fiscal 2027 earnings report and data center revenue growth.
